skills.name: discover-physical-capabilities
skills.description: Search and inspect real-world manufacturing, laboratory, logistics, and human capabilities published on PCC.

skills.name: compare-capability-options
skills.description: Retrieve valid configuration choices for a capability before requesting a price or committing to physical work.

skills.name: calculate-job-price
skills.description: Calculate a capability-specific price from selected materials, parameters, quantities, and assurance requirements.

skills.name: build-capability-contract
skills.description: Build a structured capability contract containing the selected scope, price, evidence requirements, and milestones.

skills.name: submit-and-monitor-job
skills.description: Submit physical work to an operator and monitor job state, progress, results, and evidence through the PCC API.

skills.name: verify-job-evidence
skills.description: Inspect content-addressed evidence and assurance-tier compliance before accepting the outcome of physical work.

skills.name: manage-milestone-escrow
skills.description: Fund, inspect, release, or dispute milestone escrow actions through PCC's implemented Base Sepolia settlement routes.

skills.name: orchestrate-physical-workflow
skills.description: Compose capability contracts into multi-step workflows whose dependencies can span different physical operators.

skills.name: onboard-physical-operator
skills.description: Guide a machine or service operator through configuration detection, validation, registration, and a test job.

skills.name: register-operator-device
skills.description: Register a physical device behind a Shop Kernel using a supported adapter and operator-owned configuration.

skills.name: publish-operator-capability
skills.description: Publish an operator-bound capability so agents can discover its parameters, availability, and assurance level.

skills.name: inspect-compliance-and-drift
skills.description: Read capability compliance reports, job evidence summaries, and drift alerts produced by real PCC services.
